root.label: Ukraine launches June 2025 drone attack on Russian military bases

events.label: Ukraine launches June 2025 drone attack on Russian military bases

slots.name: drones launched
slots.sentence: It was in June 2025 that Ukraine launched an audacious attack with more than 100 drones that had been hiding inside Russian shipping containers.

slots.name: bombers destroyed
slots.sentence: Ukraine says it destroyed 40 Russian bombers on four military bases thousands of miles from Ukraine's border.
